work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief VIII mandates the archbishop of Florence to suppress the Tolomei patronage benefice of St Clement and erect a Stephanian commandery with a new simple benefice; LF1425 di- → LF1434 cunt across provenance LF1428 and running title LF1431; complete 17 February 1835 closing LF1482–1485. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF1299–1299; the source closing at LF1482–1485 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die d2cima septima februarii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, pontificatus Nostri anno quinto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
